describe: The image shows a cut tree stump end-on: a large pale grey-brown wood disc with concentric growth rings and radial cracks, centred in the frame. Rough brown bark and earth surround the disc, with an orange-tan tint in the cracks near the centre. Colours are olive-grey, tan and dark brown. Lighting is soft and even with moderate contrast. The disc is one large piece, so keep it exactly in place.
